page_title: BAR 2-3 VIL | Barcelona v Villarreal 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
90+3' Raphinha (Barcelona) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
90+3' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+1' Raphinha (Barcelona) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
90+1' Raphinha (Barcelona) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
90+1' Alex Baena (Villarreal) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Barcelona have a free kick from a promising distance.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
89' Raphinha (Barcelona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

87' What a huge chance for Alex Baena (Villarreal). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
86' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) is cautioned by the referee.

86' A short pass finds Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
85' Substitution. Dani Olmo (Barcelona) has come on for Gavi.
84' The Barcelona players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
80' 2 - 3 Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes the ball into the roof of the net. What a lovely finish!
80' Neat passing move from Villarreal in order to create new attacking opportunities.
77' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) replacing Nicolas Pepe.
76' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Junior Reis intercepts the ball.
74' Hansi Flick decides to make a substitution. Robert Lewandowski will be replaced by Pau Victor (Barcelona).
74' Substitution. Eric Garcia did his best and is replaced by Hector Fort (Barcelona).
73' The attendance for today's match is 49558.
71' The referee blows for a cooling break.

70' Raphinha (Barcelona) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the right post. Very bad attempt. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
67' Barcelona control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

66' A neat pass is well received by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
64' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Willy Kambwala (Villarreal) replaces Pau Navarro.
64' Yeremy Pino is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal).

63' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Junior Reis!
63' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
63' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona). The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Barcelona.
60' Raphinha (Barcelona) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
60' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Barcelona have a corner.
58' Dani Parejo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Pape Gueye (Villarreal).
57' Raphinha (Barcelona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
55' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
54' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
54' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
50' 2 - 2 GOAL! Santi Comesana (Villarreal) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Marc-Andre ter Stegen, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 2:2.
48' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move. Villarreal win a free kick.
48' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes.
46' Half-time substitution. Ayoze Perez will not participate anymore and Thierno Barry (Villarreal) is coming on.
46' Here is a change. Gerard Martin is going off and Hansi Flick gives the last tactical orders to Alejandro Balde (Barcelona).
46' Half-time substitution. Hansi Flick decided to make a change. Pedri is replaced by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' Jose Munuera blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the Barcelona goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.

45+5' 2 - 1 Goal! Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Junior Reis is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 2:1.

45+4' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) skilfully dribbles past two defenders and runs into open space just outside the box to release a bullet. The ball only bounces off the left post, so the score doesn't change.
45+1' Alex Baena (Villarreal) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
43' The game is interrupted. Eric Garcia (Barcelona) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.

43' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
41' Alex Baena (Villarreal) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
41' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Villarreal will have a chance to score from a corner.

38' 1 - 1 Goal! Great link up play between Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) and Eric Garcia gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the left side of the goal. 1:1.
37' Alex Baena (Villarreal) whips in a cross from the corner, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen is well positioned and punches the ball away.
36' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Alex Baena (Villarreal).
35' Barcelona take a short corner kick.

34' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Junior Reis dived superbly to block a header by Eric Garcia (Barcelona) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the left post, but Junior Reis pulled off a remarkable save! Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
34' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
34' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) will take a corner kick.
33' 78:22 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
30' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
28' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Raphinha (Barcelona) blazes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
25' Referee Jose Munuera sees the trip by Juan Foyth (Villarreal) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Barcelona have a free kick.

24' Fine play by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
23' Raphinha (Barcelona) will take the corner.
23' Raphinha (Barcelona) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.

22' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Junior Reis shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. Good work from Barcelona as they win a corner.
19' Raphinha (Barcelona) serves up a nice cross, but Junior Reis punches the ball away.
17' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
16' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) fails to beat a perfect example of the offside trap.
14' Raphinha (Barcelona) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
14' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Barcelona.
11' Raphinha (Barcelona) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

10' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.
10' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) gets on the end of a cross and unleashes an explosive shot at goal from close range, but Junior Reis makes a fine one-handed save to deny him.
8' The game is interrupted as Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is flagged offside.

7' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
6' Great teamplay by Barcelona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

4' 0 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
